scope.summary: Implement sharpen/detail StudioLiveFilter kinds (redistribute existing contrast, do NOT add pixels): Sharpen / Sharpen More (fixed clarity boost), Sharpen Edges (edge-only, parameterless), Unsharp Mask (amount/radius/threshold), Smart Sharpen (algorithm choice, shadow/highlight fade, noise-reduction slider, per-channel + CMYK), Clarity (midtone local contrast), High Pass (edge detail within radius, inverse of gaussian; single deduped kind used as sharpen row AND overlay-sharpen detail extractor, not duplicated across families). ML detail synthesis is the adapter super-resolution row, not here.
acceptance_criteria: Sharpen/Sharpen More, Sharpen Edges, Unsharp Mask, Smart Sharpen, Clarity, High Pass; contrast-only; High Pass single deduped kind
expected_tests: test: Unsharp Mask amount/radius/threshold; Smart Sharpen per-channel+CMYK; High Pass single kind (no cross-family duplication)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Sharpen/detail set missing; High Pass duplicated.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
